company.shortDescription: CratD2C is a is a blockchain and cryptocurrency project that describes itself as a decentralized smart-chain platform.
company.description: CratD2C Decentralized Autonomous SmartChain is a blockchain and cryptocurrency project that describes itself as a decentralized smart-chain platform for digital commerce, decentralized applications, and blockchain-based financial services. The platform is associated with the CRAT token and promotes services related to staking, token sales, and blockchain infrastructure. The platform states that it supports multiple sectors including e-commerce, payment systems, finance, tourism, hospitality, and real estate through blockchain infrastructure and smart contract technology. The project also promotes token sale campaigns, staking programs, and decentralized finance-related use cases.
